id: \bI wanna get a Voltorb. Are there any here?
en: \bI wanna get a Voltorb. Are there any here?
it: \bVoglio prendere un Voltorb. Ce ne sono da queste parti?

id: \rThe flowers here are lovely. I could stay here forever.
en: \rThe flowers here are lovely. I could stay here forever.
it: \rI fiori qui sono deliziosi. Potrei restare qui per sempre.

id: \bI usually hold a contest in my house every year for a special prize, but a Jigglypuff came by and ruined it.
en: \bI usually hold a contest in my house every year for a special prize, but a Jigglypuff came by and ruined it.
it: \bDi solito ogni anno organizzo una gara a casa mia con un premio speciale, ma è passato un Jigglypuff e ha rovinato tutto.

id: \bSo instead I'll give you the chance to win the prize. All you have to do is guess three questions right.
en: \bSo instead I'll give you the chance to win the prize.  All you have to do is guess three questions right.
it: \bQuindi ti darò la possibilità di vincere il premio. Devi solo rispondere bene a tre domande.

id: \bQuestion 1: What is the evolved form of Grimer?
en: \bQuestion 1: What is the evolved form of Grimer?
it: \bDomanda 1: Qual è la forma evoluta di Grimer?
\bDomanda 2: Di che colore sono le guance di Raichu?

id: \bQuestion 3: Which Pokémon is associated with Volbeat?
en: \bQuestion 3: Which Pokémon is associated with Volbeat?
it: \bDomanda 3: Quale Pokémon è associato a Volbeat?

id: \bCongratulations! You answered every question right. Here is your prize, a Good Rod.
en: \bCongratulations! You answered every question right. Here is your prize, a Good Rod.
it: \bCongratulazioni! Hai risposto correttamente a tutte le domande. Ecco il tuo premio, un Amo Buono.

id: \bA Good Rod allows you to fish for better Pokémon.
en: \bA Good Rod allows you to fish for better Pokémon.
it: \bCon l'Amo Buono puoi pescare Pokémon migliori.

id: \rThis place is so beautiful. It's nice to take a break from the city.
en: \rThis place is so beautiful. It's nice to take a break from the city.
it: \rQuesto posto è bellissimo. È bello staccare un po' dalla città.

id: \rDon't forget to slow down and relax every now and then.
en: \rDon't forget to slow down and relax every now and then.
it: \rNon dimenticare di rallentare e rilassarti ogni tanto.
